*<sup>2 Cache hits and refreshes on Claude Opus 5.5 are priced at 0.05x the base input price.</sup>*
| Claude Opus 5.5                 | $8 / MTok  | $40 / MTok |  (Fast mode pricing)

Fast mode, in research preview, provides significantly faster output for Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Opus 5, and Claude Opus 4.8 at premium pricing. Fast mode pricing applies across the full context window, including requests over 200k input tokens.
The Batch API allows asynchronous processing of large volumes of requests with a 50% discount on both input and output tokens.
Claude 4.6 and later models and Claude Mythos Preview include the full 1M token context window at standard pricing. (A 900k-token request is billed at the same per-token rate as a 9k-token request.)

For Claude 4.6 and later models, specifying US-only inference through the `inference_geo` parameter incurs a 1.1x multiplier on all token pricing categories, including input tokens, output tokens, cache writes, and cache reads.
